capabilities.purpose: Produce the one governed Denmark competitor and positioning decision brief promised by v1.
capabilities.nonPurpose: General market research, buyer-demand proof, campaign analysis or autonomous recommendations.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove if the paying pilot cannot show decision value at the Blueprint quality threshold.
limitations: Target ability and decision-brief@2 do not exist in runtime.
Current code exposes separate competitor and positioning abilities.

capabilities.purpose: Expose the bounded canonical v1 tools to supported AI hosts through remote MCP.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Database access, generic CRUD, source administration or host-specific research logic.
capabilities.removalCondition: Replace only through a versioned, host-compatible protocol migration.
limitations: No MCP endpoint, protocol package, tool schema or host conformance test exists.

capabilities.purpose: Authorize delegated or workload MCP calls independently of browser sessions.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Reusing browser cookies or trusting a tenant selector supplied by a tool caller.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while remote MCP is supported; replace only through a reviewed identity migration.
limitations: Current OIDC implementation creates browser sessions and resolves identity by subject without issuer.

capabilities.purpose: Provide authorized, redacted application services shared by MCP and the web surface.
capabilities.nonPurpose: A new network microservice or duplicate business-logic layer.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while more than one product surface exists.
limitations: No application-services directory or import-boundary rule exists.

capabilities.purpose: Maintain versioned owner-declared company intent without presenting it as market evidence.
capabilities.nonPurpose: CRM ingestion, market validation or automatic truth promotion.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while client context is part of the product promise.
limitations: Not yet projected through an application service or MCP tool.

capabilities.purpose: Enforce client membership, roles, request policy and redacted governance audit.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Agent authentication or a shared multitenant data plane.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove; identity implementation may be replaced behind the policy boundary.
limitations: Implemented for browser sessions only; MCP audit context is absent.

capabilities.purpose: Declare source permissions, rights, purposes, scope, retention and health before acquisition.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Credentials, provider payloads or an assumption that public means permitted.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while external or client sources are processed.
limitations: Current JSON policies need a versioned decision and approver model before production.

capabilities.purpose: Normalize, minimize, quarantine, retain and cite evidence behind provider-neutral contracts.
capabilities.nonPurpose: A live source by itself or a place for raw provider payloads and person profiles.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove; evolve only through versioned evidence contracts.
limitations: Production adapter registry is empty; existing adapters are fixtures or manual normalization.

capabilities.purpose: Own the neutral PgBoss connection, startup, error handling and graceful shutdown used by canonical workers.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Registering the legacy research-run queue or deciding which product schedules are active.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while any durable worker exists; replace only behind the same lifecycle tests.
limitations: Legacy and transitional monitoring queue registration remains in the worker entry point until R1A2 removal.

capabilities.purpose: Schedule canonical retention, session cleanup and queued acquisition dispatch independently of parked monitoring.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Signal qualification, periodic market briefings or product monitoring.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while canonical retention or dispatch needs scheduling.
limitations: The repository implementation and automated verification are present, but release state remains designed until the source-acquisition-budget dependency and installation-specific runtime, restart, sizing, index-build and cleanup-service-objective evidence pass.
Passing repository verification does not close R0B or authorize R1A2.

capabilities.purpose: Pin the one production ability, market, language, source bindings, review roles and retention policy for an installation.
capabilities.nonPurpose: A broad portable package, customer-selectable ability marketplace or sensing profile.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while installations require governed configuration.
limitations: Current solution profiles permit the entire old ability catalog and optional sensing configuration.

capabilities.purpose: Prove isolated single-tenant deployment identity and evolve toward the managed reference service.
capabilities.nonPurpose: A shared multitenant data plane or proof that managed operations are already production-ready.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove; replace only with equal or stronger isolation evidence.
limitations: Current controls cover transitional customer-operated deployment, not the managed reference deployment.

capabilities.purpose: Acquire permitted client documents, trusted web material and licensed listening signals.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Unlimited web crawling, unrestricted social listening or synthetic fixture claims.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove any path that lacks rights, repeatable acquisition or material contribution to the pilot brief.
limitations: No live production source adapter is registered and no listening provider is selected.

capabilities.purpose: Acquire approved client documents through one production path with a live receipt.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Treating an upload or owner statement as independent market evidence.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove if approved client material is not needed for the pilot brief.
limitations: Only fixture/manual normalization exists.

capabilities.purpose: Acquire allowlisted or policy-resolved official and trusted web evidence reproducibly.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Unrestricted crawling, search-result trust or arbitrary URL ingestion.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove if it does not contribute material, reproducible evidence to the pilot.
limitations: Current public-web adapter consumes supplied fixture content and performs no network acquisition.

capabilities.purpose: Acquire aggregate, people-blind conversation signals from one approved licensed provider.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Person-level monitoring, profile enrichment or an unlimited social feed.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove if licensing or incremental decision value is not justified.
limitations: No provider, rights approval or production adapter exists.

capabilities.purpose: Select only applicable, current and permitted evidence and expose exclusions and contradictions.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Model-driven source selection or connector-count confidence.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while evidence-backed research is promised.
limitations: Most selection controls are implemented, but source diversity currently follows source connections rather than publisher/origin independence; the v1 target is therefore still designed.

capabilities.purpose: Maintain reviewed market facts, insights, hypotheses and gaps with lineage.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Consumer graphs, automatic learning or unreviewed model truth.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove record kinds not required by the production ability after the pilot.
limitations: Current model is broader than v1; there is no dedicated Market Twin insight-creation path, and review semantics are not separated for research briefs.

capabilities.purpose: Persist reproducible projects, briefs, citations and their frozen evidence/context basis.
capabilities.nonPurpose: The primary end-user workspace or an editable model-output store.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove; migrate through an explicit artifact contract.
limitations: Current artifact contract is decision-brief@1 and has no explicit brief-review record.

capabilities.purpose: Accept, reject or request revision of the exact displayed material brief after revalidation.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Changing evidence lifecycle or approving stale/unauthorized material.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while material recommendations are returned.
limitations: No brief review endpoint, state record or transaction exists.

capabilities.purpose: Run bounded, idempotent source acquisition with durable authorization and receipts.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Monitoring-specific scheduling or unbounded retry.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove while external source work exists.
limitations: Cancellation route currently lives under the monitoring namespace.

capabilities.purpose: Call one approved synthesis provider only after deterministic admission and evidence selection.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Letting a model select rights, grant citations, approve claims or bypass spend authority.
capabilities.removalCondition: Replace the provider adapter without changing Core; remove if human synthesis is selected instead.
limitations: Reference adapter is disabled by default and not accepted for production.

capabilities.purpose: Record human scorecards and expiring external release evidence without self-certification.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Treating repository tests or model confidence as external validation.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove; narrow deferred artifact types from active UI in R2.
limitations: Blueprint v2 percentage metrics and AI-host gates are not yet represented at runtime.

capabilities.purpose: Enforce canonical retention and provide tested bounded retry and circuit-breaker primitives.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Production backup/restore, integrated incident recovery or legacy evidence purging.
capabilities.removalCondition: Never remove; prove backup/restore and service objectives before production support.
limitations: Circuit-breaker primitives are not wired into every provider path; the R1A1b bounded-retention implementation is repository-verified but still lacks installation evidence, and production backup/restore evidence and service objectives do not exist.

capabilities.purpose: Provide only company context, sources/rights, review, quality and operations administration.
capabilities.nonPurpose: A second general research workspace or campaign/monitoring product.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove any page that does not support a v1 administrative or review job.
limitations: Current web app exposes campaign, monitoring, run and broad research surfaces; the public landing copy overclaims scope and the showroom exposes legacy sample runs.

capabilities.purpose: Preserve tested pre-v2 ability code temporarily while it is removed from active configuration and claims.
capabilities.nonPurpose: A supported v1 product bundle or entitlement to future roadmap priority.
capabilities.removalCondition: Delete post-pilot unless one ability wins a separate demand and quality gate.
limitations: All six current decision abilities are enabled by default and exposed in configuration.

capabilities.purpose: Preserve the existing campaign code until post-pilot deletion or a separately justified capability decision.
capabilities.nonPurpose: A supported v1 workflow, live optimization or causal claim.
capabilities.removalCondition: Delete after the v1 pilot unless measured demand selects campaign learning next.
limitations: Campaign UI and APIs are currently fully exposed.

capabilities.purpose: Preserve the tested study code temporarily without presenting Brand Lift as a v1 capability.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Production measurement, survey orchestration or a causal claim without a reviewed design.
capabilities.removalCondition: Delete after the v1 pilot unless a separate paid methodology gate is approved.
limitations: Measurement and study APIs are currently exposed.

capabilities.purpose: Preserve monitoring code temporarily while all schedules and user-facing claims are disabled.
capabilities.nonPurpose: A v1 alerting service, real-time listening or automatic action system.
capabilities.removalCondition: Delete after the v1 pilot unless proactive monitoring wins the next-capability gate.
limitations: The 15-minute monitoring scheduler, monitoring APIs and UI are active today.

capabilities.purpose: Preserve old profile import/export only until the single-ability installation contract replaces it.
capabilities.nonPurpose: An AI-host package or proof of deployment portability.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove v2/v3 broad-profile packages after migration to the v1 installation manifest.
limitations: Package contains broad ability and sensing configuration unrelated to the target host package.

capabilities.purpose: Keep the retired ingestion path fail-closed only until R1 data preflight and code detachment.
capabilities.nonPurpose: A source adapter, production dependency or fallback acquisition path.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove runtime code in R1A2 after inventory, restore and preservation/access evidence; remove schema in R1B after the separate legacy-data-disposition approval.
limitations: Still shipped through Python, Docker, a Git submodule and the worker's research-run queue.

capabilities.purpose: Keep old brand/instruction/run/insight records readable through R1A2 until R1B has a final destructive disposition.
capabilities.nonPurpose: The v1 company, project, evidence or brief model.
capabilities.removalCondition: Remove application code in R1A2 after preservation/access approval; drop approved tables in R1B only after legacy-data-disposition approval and without editing historical migrations.
limitations: Legacy evidence includes author_handle and provider-shaped social selectors.
Repository tooling cannot prove that every installation was discovered or that an approved preservation/access plan exists.
The inventory artifact covers database foreign keys and views only; source, dynamic SQL, trigger/function, scheduled-job and external-consumer audits remain separate R1A1 evidence.

capabilities.purpose: Retain schema history until the R1B forward migration removes unused delivery tables and enums.
capabilities.nonPurpose: An active delivery connector or future host integration.
capabilities.removalCondition: Drop channel and insight_route plus legacy delivery enums in R1B after row inventory.
limitations: Schema-only residue remains from removed Slack/Rill delivery.

capabilities.purpose: Retain the unused ability_manifest table only until repository governance replaces it in R1B.
capabilities.nonPurpose: Runtime activation authority or the canonical capability register.
capabilities.removalCondition: Drop in R1B after confirming zero required rows.
limitations: No runtime import exists outside the schema definition.
